name: Event Extinction
summary:
Story:
Ursalam wakes up not knowing where he is and believes he is in the present time.
But he finds himself in a world where human robots and drones are at war.
They want to kill him, control him, or worse.
Even the world itself is unnatural and has an anomaly in its reality.
He fights to survive and return home, searching for any living human beings, if any are still there.
He tries to make friends with robots to help him understand what is happening.
Description :
Open world game (includes 3 maps). Sci-f
